argv:
/system/bin/sh -c 'set -eu
b=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); test "$b" = 9f5af7c8-d359-4c25-99c6-63206b50cf0a
echo BOOT=$b
for p in /system/etc/init/00_westlake_u13_recover-v3.cfg /system/etc/init/00_westlake_u13_recover.cfg /system/etc/westlake-u13-recover-v3.sh /system/etc/westlake-u13-boat-overlay.sh /data/westlake-demo/u13/selinux-mode; do
 if [ -f "$p" ]; then sha256sum "$p"; stat -c '"'"'%a:%u:%g'"'"' "$p"; ls -ldnZ "$p"; else test ! -e "$p"; test ! -L "$p"; echo ABSENT:$p; fi
done
cat /data/westlake-demo/u13/selinux-mode
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = "$b"
'; re_rc=$?; printf "\nRE_REMOTE_RC=%s\n" "$re_rc"
